notes.title: Version 1.2.6 update
notes.content:
Version 1.2.6 is now available.

Changes:

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that didn't allow to progress between scenes when Windows language and/or locale was in languages other than English
[*] A few characters assets have been updated, they were scaled down by accident at some point during development
[*] Fixed a few typos in Episode 2
[/list]
Thank you.

notes.title: Episode 2: 'Raid & Fortress' is OUT now!
notes.content:
Episode 2 is here!

[b]What does the DLC includes?[/b]

[list]
[*]10 NEW hand drawn characters
[*]6 NEW versions of already existing characters
[*]61 NEW hand drawn backgrounds (+14 variations)
[*]67 NEW hand drawn animations and spreads
[*]13 NEW original songs
[*]4 to 6 hours in length (second episode)
[*]23 NEW sparks for you to discover
[*]5 NEW Journal and Observatorium entries
[*]6 NEW achievements
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40480033/85409323abd7af5b74383899e5060617fd65475d.png[/img]

We'll update the soundtrack with the new episode songs and a bundle with all the DLC should be up soon.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3078750/The_Scorchfarer__Episode_2_Raid__Fortress/

Enjoy the new episode!

notes.title: The Scorchfarer 1.1.1 - High resolution fix and announcement
notes.content:
Patch notes (1.1.1):

- Fixed a bug in which the Spark system would break if the game was played on higher resolutions.
- Removed ultra widescreen resolutions from being choosen, the game is forced to render in 1080p, so ultra widescreen resolutions break the game by not showing all of the assets properly (we apologize, but since the biggest assets were made in 1080p, 16:9 is the best way to experience the game)
- Changed 'Overwrite?' to 'Overwrite' on the save screen to avoid confusion
- Fixed a bug with the 'Auto mode'
- Fixed some typos

[b]We want to take this moment to let you know what we are preparing something special for all of you. It should be ready in a week or two. Let's just say it involves some goodies, so stay tuned and follow us on Twitter so you don't miss it when it drops! People that follow us before the announcement happens, will receive a special offer.[/b]

Click on the image to go to our Twitter.

[url=https://twitter.com/thescorchfarer][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40480033/d09d7fc2cf12ba20c32d0ec1b3af9c54ae11694b.png[/img][/url]

Also, we have started to work on episode 2, follow us on Discord to see a sneak peek of the new assets.

[url=https://discord.gg/e8bVG4qgqT][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40480033/aae3301cfe3fb0e24b6a997dea1847c52936df99.png[/img][/url]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1617580/The_Scorchfarer/

Thank you very much for your support.

notes.title: The Scorchfarer 1.1
notes.content:
Version 1.1 is now live. Here are the patch notes:

- New "Hide UI" mode right next to the 'exit to main menu' button
- Increased the search area of sparks by 100 pixels in every direction
- Tooltips for the scene mode buttons
- Fixed some typos
- Fixed a bug related to menus
- Made some buttons bigger and changed some text graphics for others
- Other changes

Some of you might have experienced a double update, we apologize for that.

This will be the last patch until the second episode release (unless a major bug is reported). Thank you very much for your support.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1617580/The_Scorchfarer/
